rule: Worker: a 403, a 429 or a bot challenge pauses the whole provider
expect: http_403 reporting 3600 s pauses the provider 86400 s

rule: Worker: the provider pause has a floor of a day (403, bot challenge) or six hours (429)
expect: http_403 reporting 3600 s pauses the provider 86400 s

rule: Worker: a reported wait longer than the floor is kept
expect: http_429 reporting 100000 s pauses the provider 100000 s

rule: Worker: a retried page waits the reported seconds
expect: A retried page waits the reported seconds

rule: Worker: a later save keeps the longer stored provider wait
old: ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value=CAST(MAX(CAST(catalog_meta.value AS REAL),CAST(excluded.value AS REAL)) AS TEXT)
new: ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value=excluded.value
expect: A later save must not shorten the provider wait

rule: Worker: the third failure of a page makes it failed
expect: Status and attempts after failure 3

rule: Worker contract: a record's id stands in its own property link
expect: await refused({...payload,observations:[relinked]},'Invalid catalogue observation');

rule: Worker: a record's source is the job's own page
expect: await refused({...payload,observations:[elsewhere]},'Observation does not match crawl job');

rule: Worker: a detail page is not done without a record
old: ||job.kind==='detail'&&update.status==='done'&&!update.observations.length)return Response.json({error:'Observation does not match crawl job'}
new: )return Response.json({error:'Observation does not match crawl job'}
expect: await refused({...payload,observations:[]},'Observation does not match crawl job');

rule: Worker: a job takes records of its own provider only
expect: await refused({url:listUrl,status:'done',observations:[foreign],links:[]},'Observation does not match crawl job');

rule: Worker: an older page does not replace a curated group's page
expect: An older page must not replace a curated group's page

rule: Worker: the page times of a curated group are compared as times, not as text
expect: An older page must not replace a curated group's page

rule: Worker: a list page does not replace a curated group's detail page
expect: A list page must not replace a curated group's detail page

rule: Worker: a curated property's page is saved only while a verified group names that provider record
expect: Without a verified group the page is saved nowhere

rule: Worker: a curated property's provider page does not become a hotel of its own
expect: A curated property's provider page adds no hotel

rule: Worker: a 404 or 410 on a detail page is a review signal, not a closure
expect: assert.equal(hotel.lifecycle.state,'unverified')

rule: collector: a source's Retry-After is capped at seven days
expect: A source wait is capped at seven days

rule: collector: update-site.py does not follow a Site redirect
expect: update-site.py followed a Site redirect

rule: collector: update-names.py does not follow a Site redirect
expect: update-names.py followed a Site redirect

rule: collector: update-descriptions.py does not follow a Site redirect
expect: update-descriptions.py followed a Site redirect

rule: collector: update-lifecycle.py does not follow a Site redirect
expect: update-lifecycle.py followed a Site redirect

rule: collector: update-source-groups.py does not follow a Site redirect
expect: update-source-groups.py followed a Site redirect
